decisions.decision: Built the diagram as a Starlight docs component of real HTML, embedded on the Introduction and Living specs and linked from Pick a pipeline
decisions.why: The site already embeds docs visuals as components; a page in the root docs/ folder is not rendered by the site, and a README cannot embed live HTML
decisions.rejected: A standalone HTML page in docs/, or an SVG with baked-in text

decisions.decision: Laid the diagram out with a container query on its own width
decisions.why: The docs column narrows when the sidebars open, so the viewport width says nothing about the space the figure has

decisions.decision: Taught the site prose rules to skip .not-content, the opt-out Starlight already honours
decisions.why: The site docs.css spaced every p, ul and li inside the figure by 1.7em, which no component could override without !important
decisions.rejected: Raising specificity or !important inside the component

decisions.decision: Drew converge as a dashed optional card under implement
decisions.why: It runs after implement, owns no status and completion does not wait on it; PR #813 is still open, so it is the one box to revisit if that changes
decisions.rejected: A sixth step in the pipeline row

decisions.decision: After two review rounds (code-review and Codex), Completed became implement outcome placed beside it by grid, converge moved outside the run, and the delta reviewer was dropped from the diagram
decisions.why: Implement completes the spec itself so nothing follows it; a completed spec takes no converge writes; the delta reviewer is found-not-proposed, not in any living spec
decisions.rejected: Numbering Complete as a fifth command; converge inside the implement band

decisions.decision: Kept --text-muted for the worker lines and kept titles as paragraphs
decisions.why: On the site the muted token is about 7:1 on the ground, and headings inside the figure would add noise to the page outline
decisions.rejected: Codex suggestions to switch the token and add headings
